<script type="text/javascript">
    $(function(){
        function trackReturns() {
            function dayDiff(d1, d2) {
                return Math.floor((d1-d2)/86400000);
            }
            if (!localStorage) {
                return false;
            }

            var cookieName = 'RBXReturn';
            var cookieOptions = {expires:9001};
            var cookieStr = localStorage.getItem(cookieName) || "";
            var cookie = {};

            try {
                cookie = JSON.parse(cookieStr);
            } catch (ex) {
                // busted cookie string from old previous version of the code
            }

            try {
                if (typeof cookie.ts === "undefined" || isNaN(new Date(cookie.ts))) {
                    localStorage.setItem(cookieName, JSON.stringify({ ts: new Date().toDateString() }));
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (ex) {
                return false;
            }

            var daysSinceFirstVisit = dayDiff(new Date(), new Date(cookie.ts));
            if (daysSinceFirstVisit == 1 && typeof cookie.odr === "undefined") {
                RobloxEventManager.triggerEvent('rbx_evt_odr', {});
                cookie.odr = 1;
            }
            if (daysSinceFirstVisit >= 1 && daysSinceFirstVisit <= 7 && typeof cookie.sdr === "undefined") {
                RobloxEventManager.triggerEvent('rbx_evt_sdr', {});
                cookie.sdr = 1;
            }
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(cookieName, JSON.stringify(cookie));
            } catch (ex) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        GoogleListener.init();



        RobloxEventManager.initialize(true);
        RobloxEventManager.triggerEvent('rbx_evt_pageview');
        trackReturns();
        

        RobloxEventManager._idleInterval = 450000;
        RobloxEventManager.registerCookieStoreEvent('rbx_evt_initial_install_start');
        RobloxEventManager.registerCookieStoreEvent('rbx_evt_ftp');
        RobloxEventManager.registerCookieStoreEvent('rbx_evt_initial_install_success');
        RobloxEventManager.registerCookieStoreEvent('rbx_evt_fmp');
        
    });

</script>

    ><script data-pd-guard="">(function () {
  try {
    var body = document.body;
    if (!body) return;
    function reopen() {
      [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('dialog[data-pd-modal]'), function (d) {
        try {
          d.removeAttribute('open');
          d.showModal();
        } catch (e) {
          d.setAttribute('open', '');
          d.style.cssText += ';position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;z-index:2147483647';
        }
      });
      [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-pd-popover-open]'), function (p) {
        try { p.showPopover(); } catch (e) {}
      });
    }
    reopen();
    var SKIP = { SCRIPT: 1, STYLE: 1, NOSCRIPT: 1, TEMPLATE: 1 };
    function textSize(root) {
      var n = 0;
      var w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
        acceptNode: function (t) {
          for (var p = t.parentNode; p && p !== root; p = p.parentNode) if (SKIP[p.nodeName]) return 2;
          return 1;
        }
      });
      while (w.nextNode()) n += w.currentNode.nodeValue.trim().length;
      return n;
    }
    // Duplicates: the site's scripts render again what is already in the saved page
    // (Wikipedia duplicated the "Appearance" block). If within 20 s an element is added with the same id
    // as a saved element that is still visible on the page — it is a duplicate, remove it.
    var origById = {};
    [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[id]'), function (e) { if (!origById[e.id]) origById[e.id] = e; });
    function isDup(e) {
      if (!e || e.nodeType !== 1) return false;
      var probe = e.id ? e : e.querySelector && e.querySelector('[id]');
      if (!probe || !probe.id) return false;
      var o = origById[probe.id];
      return !!(o && o !== probe && o.isConnected && !e.contains(o));
    }
    var mo = new MutationObserver(function (list) {
      list.forEach(function (m) { [].forEach.call(m.addedNodes, function (n) { if (isDup(n)) n.remove(); }); });
    });
    mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { mo.disconnect(); }, 20000);

    var saved = body.cloneNode(true);
    var savedAttrs = [].map.call(document.documentElement.attributes, function (a) { return [a.name, a.value]; });
    var base = textSize(saved);
    if (base < 200) return;
    var started = Date.now();
    function restore() {
      var html = document.documentElement;
      [].slice.call(html.attributes).forEach(function (a) { html.removeAttribute(a.name); });
      savedAttrs.forEach(function (a) { html.setAttribute(a[0], a[1]); });
      var current = document.body;
      if (current) current.replaceWith(saved); else html.appendChild(saved);
      reopen();
      window.__pdRestored = true;
      if (window.console) console.info('[Website Copier] Site scripts wiped the page — showing the saved version.');
    }
    function check() {
      var now = document.body ? textSize(document.body) : 0;
      if (now < base * 0.3) return restore();
      if (Date.now() - started < 20000) setTimeout(check, 500);
    }
    setTimeout(check, 500);
  } catch (e) {}
})();</script
